newsitem.title: UK: LME regrets Lehman's departure from exchange floor.
newsitem.headline: LME regrets Lehman's departure from exchange floor.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) said on Friday it regretted the withdrawal of Lehman Brothers Commodities from ring-dealing membership but that it recognized the company's logic in concentrating on its core business.
Lehman Brothers Commodities is a subsidiary of Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc, which said earlier this week it is to wind down its existing business in metals and energy.

In a notice LME Chief Executive David King said Lehman had advised the Exchange orally of their intention to switch to another LME clearing membership category and had undertaken to carry out this transition in an orderly manner.

"I understand from Lehman Brothers that their decision in no way reflects any concerns with respect to recent events, nor with respect to volumes traded on the LME which I can confirm on a year-to-year basis are at a comparable level to those achieved last year," King said.
